from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class ExpenseLineItem(BaseModel):
    """A specific expense line item extracted from a financial statement."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company filing this statement")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact label of the expense line item as written in the document (e.g., 'General and administrative')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numerical value of the expense")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the amount (e.g., 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions')")
    period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period end date associated with this expense")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Schema for extracting financial data from a single document."""
    expense_lines: list[ExpenseLineItem]
